acceptanceCriteria: gitauth takes its env as an argument and its tests drop t.Setenv.
gitnotes hooks travel per call and its serial tests run under t.Parallel, with the package wall time measured before and after.
body: Residual of lane PR beamfall/corvint#1526 (testscopes-1021w, V1-2293/V1-0883). gitauth tests set process env, used by scrubbedEnv, both GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES checks and the gitrun lookup of git on PATH. gitnotes serial tests mutate package hooks (verdictNow, beforePublish and others) read on every anchor path. gitnotes baseline 70.4 s at load 213. Expected: per-call env and hooks so the tests run under t.Parallel. Actual: they must run serially.
title: gitauth and gitnotes tests cannot run in parallel: process env and package-level hooks are shared
